class.name: JarVoxelBlockSdf
class.brief_description: The distance field of a block of voxels copied from a volume.
class.description: Used internally (e.g. by [JarVoxelDebris]) to cut a piece of terrain out of a volume or put it back somewhere: edits with it copy the voxels, and can carry their materials along. It cannot be set up from scripts yet.
